name: Hatfield Grid · realistic network
description: The Hatfield core grid from the ARTIS reference report: Francis Baard (4 lanes eastbound) and Pretorius (4 lanes westbound) on the 245 m block spacing, the Burnett (westbound) / Park (eastbound) one-way pair, two-way Lynnwood, Stanza Bopape, Prospect, South, Duxbury and Lunnon, and north-south Jan Shoba (divided), Grosvenor, Richard and Glyn two-way, Hilda one-way southbound and Festival one-way northbound. Lane counts, lane use and distances are simulation estimates, not survey data.

meta.axes: x increases east, y increases south (screen convention)
meta.source: ARTIS - Hatfield Realistic Traffic Network Reference Report (City of Tshwane Hatfield Metropolitan Node Precinct Plan for the road hierarchy and one-way system). Road existence, directionality and hierarchy are documented; lane counts, lane use and distances are ARTIS approximations.
meta.layout: North to south: Lunnon, Lynnwood, Duxbury, South, Burnett, Park, Prospect, Pretorius, Francis Baard, Stanza Bopape - the order of the report's core intersection diagram (section 19), with Lunnon added north of Lynnwood as a further layer. West to east: Festival, Hilda, Grosvenor, Jan Shoba, then Richard and Glyn, which the report leaves unplaced and which serve the grid north of the M2 only (Lunnon to Prospect).
meta.distanceSource: Festival-Hilda-Grosvenor-Jan Shoba stay on the fixed 245 m spacing (17.6 s at 50 km/h) along every east-west street, since the north-south streets run straight through the grid. Jan Shoba to Richard 270 m, Richard to Glyn 250 m. North-south blocks follow the report's Jan Shoba distances: Lunnon-Lynnwood 320, Lynnwood-Duxbury 280, Duxbury-South 300, South-Burnett, Burnett-Park, Park-Prospect and Prospect-Pretorius 250, Pretorius-Francis Baard 164 (as before), Francis Baard-Stanza Bopape 275.
meta.directions: Francis Baard eastbound and Pretorius westbound (the M2 pair, report sections 4-5). Burnett runs westbound: the report calls it northbound, but its junction sequence (Jan Shoba, Grosvenor, Hilda, Festival) runs east to west. Park eastbound, Hilda southbound, Festival northbound.
meta.speeds: Francis Baard, Pretorius, Lynnwood and Stanza Bopape 60 km/h; Jan Shoba, Grosvenor, Hilda and Festival 60 km/h (kept at the posted limit rather than the report's 50); every other street 50 km/h.
meta.demandSource: Sinusoidal fluctuation between min and max, 300 s period, following the report's demand hierarchy (high: Francis Baard, Pretorius, Jan Shoba, Lynnwood; medium: Burnett, Park, Grosvenor, Hilda, Festival, Stanza Bopape; lower: the rest). A simulation-demand hierarchy, not measured volumes.
meta.laneUse: Report section 22: kerb lane left + straight, inner lanes straight, median lane straight + right, minus any turn the junction does not offer (a one-way cross street only takes one of them). Pretorius & Jan Shoba has two left-turn lanes (report section 5). One entry per lane, kerb lane (leftmost, SA) first; a two-way street keys it by direction of travel.
